# Chaotically Organized AI (COAI)

> Digital lead systems for trades & local service businesses in Bakersfield and Kern County, CA. Sovereign hand-coded websites, AI call recovery, schema/AEO optimization, and local SEO — built to generate more job calls. Founder: Jason Robert Manuel.

## Services
- Signal Foundation ($1,200): Custom-coded sovereign website with geo-targeted schema, AEO-optimized content, lead capture, and Google Business Profile alignment.
- Sentinel Automation ($2,000+): Lead qualification, missed-call text-back recovery, and a 24/7 AI receptionist (Cipher), built on Signal Foundation.
- LeadShield: Missed-call recovery — auto-texts every missed caller, scores leads HOT/WARM/COLD, runs automated follow-up.

## Key Facts
- Every build is a one-time fixed price. No mandatory retainers. The client owns the code, domain, hosting, and data at handoff.
- Standard builds complete in 2–4 weeks from signed scope to live deployment.
- Stack: Next.js + HTML/CSS/JS, deployed on Vercel or Netlify. Full code access and handoff docs. No proprietary lock-in.

## Service Area
Bakersfield, Delano, Shafter, Kern County, California.
